target.title: fix(sessions): reject non-canonical raw transcript cursors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where raw transcript pagination accepted non-canonical variants of OpenClaw-issued continuation cursors. Appended junk, base64url padding, and extra JSON fields could all resume from the same SQLite transcript position as the canonical cursor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Raw transcript cursors now require both their base64url bytes and their complete decoded envelope to round-trip exactly to OpenClaw's encoder output. This follows the existing Plugin SDK contract: `SessionTranscriptRawDeltaLimits.cursor` is documented as an opaque cursor returned by a prior page, and `docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md` tells callers to pass the opaque `page.cursor` into the next call. The only bundled runtime caller does not rewrite cursors, and the same canonical round-trip rule is already used by the ACP, OpenCode, and Pi opaque cursor parsers. Pagination queries, cursor fields, reset reasons, and the SQLite schema are unchanged.

The compatibility risk is bounded to undocumented cursor rewriting. No public `v*` release tag contains the commit that introduced `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta()`; `v2026.7.2-beta.3`, the newest published release when checked, predates it.

## User Impact

Malformed or structurally altered raw transcript cursors now return the existing `invalid_cursor` reset instead of silently continuing from an equivalent position. Canonical cursors emitted by OpenClaw continue to page normally.

## Evidence

On Node v24.18.0, I drove the real `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta()` SDK runtime against a real temporary SQLite transcript store. The same harness inserted transcript events, read the first page, then supplied its canonical cursor and three altered variants. `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` was isolated to a temporary proof directory.

Before, using the unmodified `upstream/main` production file, every cursor variant continued as a page:

```text
BEFORE canonical: page
BEFORE appendedJunk: page
BEFORE padding: page
BEFORE extraField: page
```

After the fix, canonical continuation still works while all non-canonical variants take the existing reset path:

```text
AFTER canonical: page
AFTER appendedJunk: reset invalid_cursor
AFTER padding: reset invalid_cursor
AFTER extraField: reset invalid_cursor
```

Contract and release checks:

```text
docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md: Pass the opaque page.cursor into the next call.
src/config/sessions/session-accessor.types.ts: Opaque cursor returned by a prior page or reset result.
git tag --contains 3bac9093d84 --list "v*"
# no output
git merge-base --is-ancestor 3bac9093d84 v2026.7.2-beta.3
# exit 1: beta.3 predates the raw cursor API
```

Focused and targeted checks after merging current `upstream/main`:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       20 passed (20)

./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-delta.ts src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-delta.ts src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.test.ts
# exit 0

git diff --check
# exit 0
```

The repository lint wrapper could not reach its lint phase because the existing linked-worktree dependency install reports unrelated `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` type errors after the latest main merge; the target files pass direct `oxlint`, and the fresh fork CI run covers the full repository gates. No live agent turn was run; the affected behavior is fully exercised through the production SDK runtime and SQLite store without substituting the cursor parser or database path.

AI-assisted: Codex helped implement and review the change; the production-path proof and focused test were run manually.
